newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Cimpor concludes purchase of SERRANA.
newsitem.headline: Cimpor concludes purchase of SERRANA.

text.p: Portuguese cement group Cimpor-Cimentos de Portugal has concluded its purchase of the cement business of the Brazilian group SERRANA, the Lisbon bourse bulletin said.

"This acquisition took place via the purchase by (Cimpor's subsidiary) Corporacion Noroeste of 76.6 percent of the capital of a Brazilian company created (for the transaction), Sociedade de Participacoes Cimenteiras," the bulletin said.

In January, Cimpor acquired CISAFRA, a cement producer, and the SERRANA group's cement business, for 62 billion escudos. The companies together account for five percent of the growing Brazilian market.
Cimpor shares closed on Lisbon bourse yesterday at 4,153 escudos.
